verdict: A Meta outage stalled delivery mid-week; pipeline intake needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 80 leads at an average cost of $24.28 per lead, but this past week took a hit: Meta went dark August 6–7 with zero spend and zero leads on both days, which drove a 48% week-over-week lead drop and pushed cost per lead up 38% for the 7-day window. That disruption also suppressed Google Business Profile activity and Instagram reach on the same days, so the dip across channels traces to one cause, not a broad performance decline. Delivery has resumed and we're monitoring spend stabilization closely. Separately, your intake pipeline shows 80 leads arriving over the period but no opportunities or appointments logged — we're working with your team to close that gap so leads are moving forward once they arrive.
